intro_en.short: Every midnight, one button lights up on an old vending machine and a strange item drops out. Poco, a tiny felt delivery robot, tries each one.
intro_en.long: In a small town at night stands an old vending machine. At midnight, a single button lights up and one mysterious item appears. Poco, a tiny delivery robot carrying a parcel whose address has faded away, receives the item every night and tries it out. Mochi, a soft white creature who lives inside the machine, quietly watches from the retrieval slot.
